sections.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subheadline: Details to help you prepare for your time with us.

items.title: How do I know which color service to book?
items.description: If you are unsure whether your desired look requires a partial placement or a full transformation, we highly recommend booking a complimentary 15-minute consultation prior to scheduling your service.

items.title: What product lines do you carry?
items.description: We partner exclusively with luxury, sustainably sourced botanical brands. Our products are chosen for their performance and their commitment to clean, gentle ingredients.

items.title: Is parking available near the studio?
items.description: Located in the heart of the Mission District, street parking is available but can be limited. We suggest arriving 15 minutes prior to your appointment time to find a space comfortably.

items.title: What is your cancellation policy?
items.description: We respectfully request 48 hours notice for cancellations or rescheduling. This allows our stylists to offer that time to clients on our waitlist.
